infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is read when you check in or out, and between check-in and check-out to tell HR if you leave the office.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Between check-in and check-out the app notes roughly where you are so HR can see if you leave the office without a reason. It stops when you check out.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: A selfie is taken when you check in or out.
